title: MOTION (PRICE - JURADO) relative to a reversion and reprogramming of funding from the Transfer of Floor Area Ratio (TFAR) Public Benefit Trust Fund (Trust…
text:
[Council File 14-1411-S5]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PRICE - JURADO) relative to a reversion and reprogramming of funding from the Transfer of Floor Area Ratio (TFAR) Public Benefit Trust Fund (Trust Fund).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. APPROVE the revision and reprogramming of TFAR Trust Fund public benefit projects and programs as follows:
a. Revert $1,000,000 from the Council District 9 Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 48X, Account NO. 14C085 (First Time Homebuyers Down Payment Assistance Program) (C.F. 14-1411-S5) to the Transfer of Floor Area Ratio Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 522/14, Account No. 14001A.
b. Transfer and appropriate $500,000 from the Transfer of Floor Area Ratio Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 552/14, Account No. 14001A, to the Council District 9 Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 48X, Account No. (TBD) (Heart of Los Angeles Youth Development Program) separate from funds held in Account No. 14A046 (All People’s Community Center Youth Development Program) (C.F. 14-1411-S5) and authorize the Heart of Los Angeles, a 501(c)3 organization, as the service provider and recipient of funds for the program.
c. Transfer and appropriate $500,000 from the Transfer of Floor Area Ratio Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 55/14, Account No. 14001S, to the Council District 9 Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 48X, Account No. 14C090 (Community Grants Program) (C.F. 14-1411-S5) to increase the approved amount from $1,736,395.16 to $2,236,395.16.
2. AUTHORIZE the City Controller to implement these instructions consistent with the recommendations in this report to allocate and expend funds for these projects/programs.
3. AUTHORIZE the Chief Legislative Analyst to make any technical adjustments that may be required and are consistent with this action.
